items.text: HEG Graphite (renamed HEG Limited on 12 October 2026) lists in late October: once it trades, give it a business card with its call, and track its ₹650cr electrode expansion to 115,000 tonnes (due early 2028) as a project. No sector-note main page work. Checked 7 Nov 2026: not listed yet.
Compare the exchange transcript pull with Tijori for the Q2 season, then decide whether to retire Tijori.

About twenty project follow-ups raised 1–6 November (plant starts and new capex at Quality Power, Madhya Bharat, Aarti Industries, Studds, Narayana, OBSC, Balaji Amines, Saatvik, Century Ply, Gopal Snacks, KIMS, Sai Parenterals, Nelcast, HEG, Amara Raja, Medanta, Exide, M&B, Happy Forgings, KSH) are still open behind the 40-a-run limit; give them a batch session to update projects, milestones and capacity pictures.

Top 12 check for M&B Engineering: H1 FY27 operating cash was +₹4.5cr only because ₹37.8cr of 'other bank balances' was released inside operating cash; without it, about −₹33cr. Confirm from the Q2 call or the company whether that is IPO deposit money; if so its break trigger (H1 operating cash negative excluding IPO deposits) is hit and the idea needs re-sizing or moving to the reserve list.

Sharda Cropchem hit a Top 12 break trigger (volume down a second straight quarter, −5.1% in Q2 FY27); it still earns about 22% a year at today's price on unchanged numbers. Decide whether to keep it or swap it for Mahindra Lifespace (about 22% now) from the reserve list.

About 233 Q2 FY27 results-call follow-ups (and 69 automatically settled checkpoints) are still open: 339 follow-ups in all after the 13 Nov run handled 24. At up to 40 a run this takes two weeks or more, so consider a backlog session for the follow and wait names.

The evening results job compared Q2 FY27 with June 2025 instead of September 2025 when Screener's table skips a quarter (Allcargo Global, Skyways, Behari Lal, TAC Security on 18 Nov; corrected by hand): fix how it picks the year-ago column.
